video_title: If the Spurs lose tonight, is the series OVER?! Goodwill says YES, but Windy says NO! 👀 | Get Up

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the Spurs' need for a better mental state
quotes.excerpt: We need to approach the game with a better mental state and we just need to play our game.
quotes.quote: We need to approach the game with a better mental state and we just need to play our game. We just need to be normal. Normal means trusting each other, trusting the basketball gods, trusting the game plan, executing. We've been playing a certain way all season and we've been successful this way and there's no reason to change the day the Finals start.

quotes.speaker: Stephon Castle
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephon Castle on the Spurs' confidence despite losing Game 1
quotes.excerpt: I don't think we have anything to be too worried about. We feel like we're the better team.
quotes.quote: I don't think we have anything to be too worried about. We feel like we're the better team. We didn't play well and still had a chance to win. If we take one thing from that, just going back to being ourselves and focusing on the right things.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on the Spurs' ability to rebound after losses
quotes.excerpt: They are 4-1 coming off of losses in this postseason. They've always rebounded.
quotes.quote: They are 4-1 coming off of losses in this postseason. They lost Game 1 at home to the Wolves in the second round where Victor had a poor game, and they've always rebounded. I've watched this Knicks team repeatedly frustrate and outperform what the opponent is expecting, and win 12 straight playoff games, seven of them on the road. I get why the Spurs are confident, but I'm very much wide awake by what I've seen the Knicks do in beating opponent after opponent in this postseason.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Monica McNutt on the Knicks' collective experience and confidence
quotes.excerpt: There's a level of confidence for them that they're just going to figure it out.
quotes.quote: There's a level of confidence for them that they're just going to figure it out. They've got Jaylen Brunson. They are so honest and raw with one another in terms of being accountable. There's not many times in a postseason where I think the regular season matters as much as it does in this particular matchup. The Knicks have been one of the teams that have played the Spurs and Victor Wembanyama very well in the regular season, bears that out and so did Game 1.

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: Vincent Goodwill on De'Aaron Fox's performance and the Spurs' urgency
quotes.excerpt: Since he's gotten that right ankle injury in round two, he has not looked like the max player.
quotes.quote: I want to see if De'Aaron Fox can look like himself. Since he's gotten that right ankle injury in round two, he has not looked like the max player that they've acquired him to be. It's one of those things that you're wondering, are you going to stick with your vet and your leader because he's that way and you want to trust him, or do you want to run with a guy like Dylan Harper and giving him the runway to do what he does? His athleticism was overwhelming in Game 1. I wonder if they go back to that. It's funny, you had that graphic up about the 93 Suns and the 95 Orlando Magic. That was when Nick Anderson missed the four free throws in a row, they lost the game in overtime, it was a big-time collapse and they never recovered. That was the Shaq and Penny Hardaway team that never won a playoff series leading up into the NBA Finals that season. Maybe they should be approaching tonight with a little more urgency. Not panic, urgency.

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: Vincent Goodwill on the Spurs' dire situation in Game 2
quotes.excerpt: If the Knicks are the better team, there's not going to be an adjustment that the Spurs can make.
quotes.quote: If the Knicks are the better team, there's not going to be an adjustment that the Spurs can make out of the way of panic that can delay the inevitable. The Spurs are better off losing on their terms than losing trying to be something that they're not.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Monica McNutt on potential defensive adjustments for the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: I do think that we might see the swap in terms of the Spurs how they want to defend.
quotes.quote: I do think that we might see the swap in terms of the Spurs how they want to defend to allow Victor to roam a little bit. And we have seen Cat maybe not always be as aggressive when he's played by smaller defenders who want to get after his legs. I think he has turned a corner, but I do wonder what that adjustment might offer on behalf of the Spurs.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst on the Spurs' need for better ball movement
quotes.excerpt: They are not a team that has 16 assists in a 48-minute game.
quotes.quote: The Spurs looked at the box score at the end of the game and saw 16 assists and slapped their heads. They are not a team that has 16 assists in a 48-minute game. You're going to see increased ball movement. And look, I know Victor Wembanyama has guard skills, but he is not an iso player against Carl Towns. They are not going to let him isolate 15, 18, 20 times in this game like they did in Game 1. You're going to see pick and rolls come back, you're going to see them trying to get lobs come back, and most importantly, they're probably going to try to get Carl Towns into foul trouble because that has been a bugaboo throughout his career.

quotes.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: Vincent Goodwill and Mike Greenberg on the Spurs' must-win situation
quotes.excerpt: If the Spurs lose tonight, the season is over. If they lose tonight, they're going to get swept.

text_blocks.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
text_blocks.text: Greeny, if the Spurs lose tonight, the season is over. If they lose tonight, they're going to get swept. All right? They can't lose tonight.

text_blocks.speaker: Mike Greenberg
text_blocks.text: Do we agree with that? Do we agree that if the Spurs lose tonight, this series doesn't even make it back to San Antonio for Game 5?

text_blocks.speaker: Vincent Goodwill
text_blocks.text: I do not agree with that, but I would highly recommend the Spurs win.
